title: Jubilees 7 — Noah's vineyard, the curse of Canaan, and Noah's testament

translation.sourceText: Jubilees — per-verse layered-witness reconstruction (Ge'ez-only for chapter 7; 11Q12 sparse but not preserved at verse-level). Ge'ez per Charles 1902 PD + VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511.
translation.sourceLicense: Best-effort reconstruction; scholarly editions cited; English original to this project

paragraphs.text: ወበ፫ ሰቡዕ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ተከለ፡ ኖኅ፡ ወይነ፡ በደብር፡ ዘሎቱ፡ ስሙ፡ ሉብር፡ እምነ፡ አድባር፡ ዘአራራት፡ ኀበ፡ ቆመት፡ ታቦት፡ ወአፍረየ፡ ፍሬ፡ በራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-3 sabuʿ la-zəntu ʾiyobēləwu takala Noḫ wayna ba-dabr zalottu səmu Lubar ʾəm-nə ʾadbār zaʾArārāt ḫaba qomat tābot wa-ʾafraya fəre ba-rābəʿ ʿāmat

i18n.en: And in the third week of this jubilee Noah planted a vine on the mountain whose name was Lubar — one of the mountains of Ararat — on which the ark had rested; and it bore fruit in the fourth year.

paragraphs.text: ወዐቀቦ፡ እስከ፡ ዓመት፡ ኃምስ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ለዕለተ፡ በዓል፡ ወአፍረየ፡ ፍሬ፡ ምልዕተ፡ ለመሥዋዕት፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚእ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ዘሰብዐ፡ ላሕም፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ዘሐነጾ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʿaqabō ʾəska ʿāmat ḫāməs la-zəntu sabuʿ la-ʿəlata baʿāl wa-ʾafraya fəre mələʿta la-maśwāʿt qədma ʾəgziʾ lāʿla məśwāʿ qadāmāwi zasabʿa lāḥm lāʿla məśwāʿ zaḥanaḍo

i18n.en: And he kept it until the fifth year of this week, until the day of the feast; and he produced abundant fruit for an offering before the Lord upon the altar — together with a bullock — on the altar which he had built.

paragraphs.text: ወአዕረገ፡ ዐምድ፡ ዐርዘ፡ ጼዓዳ፡ በውስቴቱ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ወሥዋዐ፡ ሐዱደ፡ ዘላሕም፡ ወአዕረገ፡ ደሞ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ላዕለ፡ መጠረተ፡ ሥርቀተ፡ ዘፍሬሁ፡ ለመጠን፡ ዕጣን፡ ወቅዱስ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾaʿraga ʿaməd ʿarza ṣēʿādā ba-wəstētu lāʿla məśwāʿ wa-śwāʿa ḥaddudē zalāḥm wa-ʾaʿraga damo lāʿla məśwāʿ lāʿla maṭarata śərqata zafərehu la-maṭan ʿəṭān wa-qəddusə

i18n.en: And he offered up a young bullock and a ram and a sheep and goats upon the altar, with a meal-offering — and he poured out the blood upon the altar; and he placed upon them all an offering mingled with oil — for an incense and a holy thing.

paragraphs.text: ወአዕረገ፡ ኵሎ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ወወደየ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብር፡ ጼዐደ፡ ወባሕተ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለመሐራቅ፡ ለፀዳይ፡ ዘመዓዛ፡ ሠናይ፡ ዘይትፈቀር፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚእ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾaʿraga kwəlo maśwāʿta lāʿla məśwāʿ wa-wadaya lāʿla kwəlu gəbər ṣēʿada wa-bāḥta lottu la-maḥarāq la-ḍaday zamaʿāzā śannāy zayətfaqqar qədma ʾəgziʾ

i18n.en: And he offered up all the sacrifice upon the altar, and he placed upon each portion frankincense; and he kindled it for a burnt-offering — for a sweet savor that is acceptable before the Lord.

paragraphs.text: ወአፍሰሰ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ዘወይን፡ ወዘዘይት፡ ላዕለ፡ ቍርባን፡ ወአዕረገ፡ ዕፃተ፡ ላዕለ፡ እሳት፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ወቆርበቶ፡ ለዘይት፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾafsasa lāʿla məśwāʿ zawayən wa-zazaytə lāʿla qurbān wa-ʾaʿraga ʿəḍāta lāʿla ʾəsāt lāʿlēhu wa-qorbato la-zaytə lāʿla məśwāʿ

i18n.en: And he poured upon the altar a libation of wine and of oil upon the offering; and he placed it upon the fire that was on the altar, and an offering of oil he set upon the altar.

paragraphs.text: ወእምድኅረዝ፡ ሰትዩ፡ ኢሙንቱ፡ በውእቱ፡ ደብር፡ ወአቀመ፡ ኖኅ፡ በዓላተ፡ ለዘርዑ፡ ለፍሥሐ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ፡ ለእግዚእ፡ በዓመት፡ ለ፫ ሰቡዕ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmdəḫrazə satyu ʾəmuntu ba-wəʾtu dabr wa-ʾaqama Noḫ baʿālāta la-zarʿu la-fəśḥā qədmēhomu la-ʾəgziʾ ba-ʿāmat la-3 sabuʿ

i18n.en: And after this they drank upon that mountain; and Noah established a feast for his seed — for a rejoicing before the Lord — in the third week year by year.

paragraphs.text: ወሰትየ፡ ኖኅ፡ እምነ፡ ወይኑ፡ ወሰክረ፡ ወአዕረፈ፡ በማእከለ፡ ድንኳኑ፡ ወዕሩቅ፡ ይከውን፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-satya Noḫ ʾəm-nə waynu wa-sakra wa-ʾaʿrafa ba-māʾkala dənkwānu wa-ʿəruq yəkawwən

i18n.en: And Noah drank of his wine, and was drunk; and he lay down in the midst of his tent, and was uncovered.

paragraphs.text: ወርእዮ፡ ሐም፡ ለኖኅ፡ አቡሁ፡ ዕሩቀ፡ ወወፅአ፡ ወዜነዎሙ፡ ለ፪ አኀዊሁ፡ ለአፍኣ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-rəʾəyo Ḥam la-Noḫ ʾabbuhu ʿəruqa wa-waḍʾa wa-zēnnawomu la-2 ʾəḫawihu la-ʾafʾā

i18n.en: And Ham saw Noah his father naked, and went out and told his two brothers outside.

paragraphs.text: ወነሥአ፡ ሴም፡ ልብሰ፡ ወአንሥአ፡ ወቀመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወያፌት፡ ወአልበስዎ፡ ለአቡሆሙ፡ እንዘ፡ ይትገሐሡ፡ ድኅረ፡ ወይከድኑ፡ ሐፍረቶ፡ ለአቡሆሙ፡ ወገጾሙ፡ ድኅረ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-naśʾa Sēm ləbsa wa-ʾansəʾa wa-qoma wəʾtu wa-Yāfet wa-ʾalbasəwo la-ʾabbuhomu ʾənza yətgaḥaśu dəḫra wa-yəkadnu ḥafrato la-ʾabbuhomu wa-gaṣṣomu dəḫra

i18n.en: And Shem took a garment and arose, and stood — he and Japheth — and they clothed their father, going backwards, and they covered the nakedness of their father, with their faces turned away.

paragraphs.text: ወአንቅሐ፡ ኖኅ፡ እምነ፡ ወይኑ፡ ወአእመረ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘገብሩ፡ ሎቱ፡ ደቂቁ፡ ወረገሞ፡ ለወልዱ፡ ወይቤ፡ ርጉም፡ ከንዓን፡ ገብረ፡ ገበር፡ ይኩን፡ ለአኀዊሁ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾanqəḥa Noḫ ʾəm-nə waynu wa-ʾaʾəmara kwəlu zagabru lottu daqiqu wa-ragagamo la-waldu wa-yəbē rəgum Kanʿān gabra gabar yəkun la-ʾəḫawihu

i18n.en: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew all that his sons had done to him; and he cursed his grandson, and said: Cursed be Canaan — a slave of slaves shall he be to his brothers.

paragraphs.text: ወባረኮ፡ ለሴም፡ ወይቤ፡ ቡሩክ፡ እግዚእ፡ አምላከ፡ ሴም፡ ወይኩን፡ ከንዓን፡ ገብሮሙ፡ ወያሥፍሕ፡ እግዚእ፡ ለያፌት፡ ወይኅድር፡ ውስተ፡ ድንኳነ፡ ሴም፡ ወይኩን፡ ከንዓን፡ ገብሮሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-bārakō la-Sēm wa-yəbē buruk ʾəgziʾ ʾamlāka Sēm wa-yəkun Kanʿān gabromu wa-yāśfəḥ ʾəgziʾ la-Yāfet wa-yəḫdər wəsta dənkwāna Sēm wa-yəkun Kanʿān gabromu

i18n.en: And he blessed Shem, and said: Blessed be the Lord God of Shem, and let Canaan be their servant; may the Lord enlarge Japheth, and may he dwell in the tents of Shem, and let Canaan be their servant.

paragraphs.text: ወከንዐንሰ፡ ኢተአተወ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ አላ፡ ቦአ፡ ምድረ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ እምነ፡ ዮርዳኖስ፡ እስከ፡ ግብጽ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ አርያውያን፡ ወአልዘበ፡ ምድረ፡ በዓቅም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-Kanʿānsa ʾi-taʾatawa məslēhu ʾallā boʾa mədra Libānos ʾəm-nə Yordānos ʾəska Gəbṣ kwəlomu ʾaryāwəyān wa-ʾalzaba mədra ba-ʿaqəm

i18n.en: And as for Canaan, he did not depart with his brothers; but he entered the land of Lebanon — from the Jordan to the border of Egypt — together with all the Canaanites, and he seized the land by violence.

paragraphs.text: ወይቤሎ፡ ሐም፡ አቡሁ፡ ወካም፡ ወያፌት፡ አኀዊሁ፡ አንተ፡ ሰሐትከ፡ በምድር፡ ዘአኮ፡ መክፈልትከ፡ ወአኮ፡ በተወልዶ፡ ለነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሥርዐት፡ ላዕሌከ፡ ርጉም፡ አንተ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəbēlo Ḥam ʾabbuhu wa-Kām wa-Yāfet ʾəḫawihu ʾanta saḥatka ba-mədr za-ʾakko makfaltka wa-ʾakko ba-tawaldo lana mawāʿəla śərʿat lāʿlēka rəgum ʾanta

i18n.en: And Ham his father, and Cush and Japheth his brothers, said to him: You have erred concerning land which was not yours by lot, and which was not given to you on the day when the ordinance was made for us; cursed are you.

paragraphs.text: ወአንተ፡ ኢሰማዕከ፡ ቃለነ፡ ወአፅሐድከ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ወውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ዘአኮ፡ መክፈልትከ፡ ሰፈርከ፡ በእንተዝ፡ ርጉም፡ አንተ፡ ወትከውን፡ ርጉመ፡ ኵሎ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾanta ʾi-samaʿka qālana wa-ʾaḍḥadka śərʿata wa-wəsta mədr za-ʾakko makfaltka safarka ba-ʾəntazə rəgum ʾanta wa-təkawwən rəguma kwəlu daqiqa sabʾ

i18n.en: And you did not hearken to our word, but transgressed the ordinance, and into a land that was not your portion you settled. On account of this, cursed are you, and you shall become a curse among all the sons of men.

paragraphs.text: ወአንቀጸ፡ ኖኅ፡ በውእቱ፡ ደብር፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ወአዘዞሙ፡ በብሕታዊት፡ ለልሕናጻዊ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾanqaḍa Noḫ ba-wəʾtu dabr śərʿata la-daqiqu wa-ʾazazomu ba-bəḥtāwit la-ləḥnāḍāwi

i18n.en: And Noah appointed on that mountain an ordinance for his sons, and he commanded them in solitude to build for themselves.

paragraphs.text: ወወለደ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለኖኅ፡ ወልደ፡ ራብዐ፡ ድኅረ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኪዳን፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ናፍ፡ እስመ፡ ይቤ፡ ናፍ፡ ፈረየ፡ ሊተ፡ እግዚእ፡ ድኅረ፡ ማየ፡ አይኅ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-walada lottu la-Noḫ walda rābəʿa dəḫra zəntu kidān wa-samayō səmō Nāf ʾəsma yəbē Nāf faraya lita ʾəgziʾ dəḫra māya ʾāyəḫ

i18n.en: And a fourth son was born to Noah after this covenant; and he called his name Naph, for he said: Naph — the Lord has made a fruitful one for me after the waters of the flood.

paragraphs.text: ወወለደ፡ ሴም፡ ለ፭ ደቂቅ፡ ኤላም፡ ወአሱር፡ ወአርፋክሰድ፡ ወአራም፡ ወሊዶ፡ ወወለደ፡ ሐም፡ ለ፬ ደቂቅ፡ ኩሽ፡ ወምስር፡ ወፉጥ፡ ወከንዓን፡ ወወለደ፡ ያፌት፡ ለ፯ ደቂቅ፡ ጎሜር፡ ወማጎጎ፡ ወማዳይ፡ ወያዋን፡ ወቱባል፡ ወሞሰሐ፡ ወቲራስ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-walada Sēm la-5 daqiq ʾElām wa-ʾAsur wa-ʾArfaksad wa-ʾArām wa-Liddo wa-walada Ḥam la-4 daqiq Kuš wa-Məsr wa-Fuṭ wa-Kanʿān wa-walada Yāfet la-7 daqiq Gomer wa-Magog wa-Māday wa-Yāwān wa-Tubāl wa-Mosaḥ wa-Tirās

i18n.en: And Shem begot five sons: Elam and Asshur and Arpachshad and Aram and Lud. And Ham begot four sons: Cush and Mizraim and Put and Canaan. And Japheth begot seven sons: Gomer and Magog and Madai and Javan and Tubal and Meshech and Tiras.

paragraphs.text: ወበፍጻሜ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ዘ፴ ጸውዐ፡ ኖኅ፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ውሉዶሙ፡ ወአኀዘ፡ ይዕዘዞሙ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘያአምር፡ ወአስምዐ፡ ላዕለ፡ ደቂቁ፡ ከመ፡ ይዕቀቡ፡ ጽድቀ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-fəṣṣāmē ʾiyobēləwu za-30 ṣawʿa Noḫ la-daqiqu wəludomu wa-ʾaḫaza yəʿzəzomu śərʿata kwəlo zayāʾammər wa-ʾasmaʿa lāʿla daqiqu kama yəʿqabu ṣədqa

i18n.en: And at the end of the thirtieth jubilee Noah called his sons and their children; and he began to enjoin upon them every ordinance which he knew, and he testified to his sons that they should keep righteousness.

paragraphs.text: ወአስምዐ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ወአዘዞሙ፡ ከመ፡ ይግበሩ፡ ጽድቀ፡ ወከመ፡ ይክድኑ፡ ሐፍረተ፡ ሥጋሆሙ፡ ወከመ፡ ይባርኩ፡ ለፈጣሪሆሙ፡ ወከመ፡ ያክብሩ፡ አበ፡ ወእመ፡ ወከመ፡ ያፍቅሩ፡ ቢጾሙ፡ ወከመ፡ ይዕቀቡ፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ እምነ፡ ዝሙት፡ ወእምነ፡ ርኵስ፡ ወእምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዐመፃ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾasmaʿa lāʿlēhomu śərʿata wa-ʾazazomu kama yəgbaru ṣədqa wa-kama yəkdənu ḥafrata śəgāhomu wa-kama yəbāraku la-faṭārihomu wa-kama yākbəru ʾaba wa-ʾəmma wa-kama yāfqəru biṣomu wa-kama yəʿqabu nafsomu ʾəm-nə zəmut wa-ʾəm-nə rəkws wa-ʾəm-nə kwəlu ʿamaḍā

i18n.en: And he testified to them the ordinance, and commanded them to do righteousness, and to cover the shame of their flesh, and to bless their Creator, and to honor father and mother, and to love their neighbor, and to keep their souls from fornication and from uncleanness and from all iniquity.

paragraphs.text: እስመ፡ በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ መጽአ፡ አይኅ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ እስመ፡ ዘመው፡ ወእስመ፡ አርኰሱ፡ ምድረ፡ ወእስመ፡ ግፍዕ፡ ኮነ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: ʾəsma ba-ʾənta zəntu śalastu maṣʾa ʾāyəḫ lāʿla mədr ʾəsma zammawu wa-ʾəsma ʾarkwasu mədra wa-ʾəsma gəfʿa kona lāʿla mədr

i18n.en: For on account of these three things came the flood upon the earth — for fornication, and for uncleanness, and for violence which was upon the earth.

paragraphs.text: እስመ፡ ዘመው፡ ትጉሃን፡ ምስለ፡ አንስት፡ ወአንስት፡ እምነ፡ ዘፈቀዱ፡ ይቤዙ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወአኀዙ፡ ይትሐናኰው፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ ወወለዱ፡ ሎሙ፡ ውሉደ፡ ወውእቶሙ፡ ሀለዉ፡ ኄሊያን፡
paragraphs.translit: ʾəsma zammawu Təguhānə məsla ʾanəst wa-ʾanəst ʾəm-nə zafaqadu yəbēzu kiyāhomu wa-ʾaḫazu yətḥanāwwə məslēhomu wa-waladu lomu wəluda wa-wəʾətomu hallawu Ḥeliyān

i18n.en: For the Watchers fornicated with the daughters of men — having taken to themselves wives of whomever they chose — and they began to commingle with them, and they bore for them sons; and these were the giants.

notes.official: Noah's testament recap of the Watchers narrative — confirms the Jubilees-distinctive tripartite giant-typology (Naphidim + Nephilim + Elyo at 7:22).

paragraphs.text: ወወለዱ፡ ኄሊያን፡ ለናፊል፡ ወአልጨቅ፡ ቆሙ፡ ኵሉ፡ እምነ፡ ካልኡ፡ በመጠን፡ ኂሩቶሙ፡ ወያቴሥቅሉ፡ አሐዱ፡ ካልኦ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-waladu Ḥeliyān la-Nāfil wa-ʾalṣaqq qomu kwəlu ʾəm-nə kāləʾu ba-maṭan ḥirutomu wa-yātēśqəlu ʾaḥadu kāləʾo

i18n.en: And the giants begot the Naphidim, and the Naphidim begot the Elyo; and one would rise against another according to the measure of his strength, and they would destroy one another.

paragraphs.text: ወብዝኆሙ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዐመፃ፡ በምድር፡ ወአርኰሰ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥጋ፡ ፍኖቶ፡ እምነ፡ ሰብእ፡ እስከ፡ እንስሳ፡ ወእስከ፡ አራዊት፡ ወእስከ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ወእስከ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-bəzəḫomu sabʾ ʿamaḍā ba-mədr wa-ʾarkwasa kwəlu śəgā fənoto ʾəm-nə sabʾ ʾəska ʾənəssā wa-ʾəska ʾarāwit wa-ʾəska ʾaʿwāf wa-ʾəska kwəlu zayətḥawwas lāʿla mədr

i18n.en: And iniquity was multiplied among men upon the earth; and all flesh corrupted its way — men, and cattle, and beasts, and birds, and everything that moves upon the earth.

paragraphs.text: ወአኀዙ፡ ይትበላዕ፡ አሐዱ፡ ለካልኡ፡ ወቦኡ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግፍዕ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወይክዕው፡ ደመ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ወይትገበር፡ ዕልወት፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾaḫazu yətballāʿ ʾaḥadu la-kāləʾu wa-boʾu kwəlu gəfʿa lāʿla mədr wa-yəkəʿwə dama bəzuḫa wa-yətgabbar ʿəlwat lāʿla mədr

i18n.en: And they began to devour one another; and all violence came upon the earth, and they shed much blood, and lawlessness was wrought upon the earth.

paragraphs.text: ወአስተአተተ፡ እግዚእ፡ ኵሎ፡ ግዕዘ፡ ሥጋ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ በእንተ፡ ዐመፃሆሙ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾastaʾtata ʾəgziʾ kwəlo gəʿza śəgā ʾəm-nə mədr ba-ʾənta ʿamaḍāhomu lāʿla mədr

i18n.en: And the Lord destroyed every nature of flesh from the earth — on account of their iniquity upon the earth.

paragraphs.text: ወአንሰ፡ ናሁ፡ ናስተአተት፡ ካዕበ፡ መውት፡ ለደቂቅነ፡ እኅዜ፡ አንሰ፡ ናሁ፡ እሬእይ፡ መውዓ፡ ለሰብእ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾansa nāhu nāstaʾtat kāʿba mawt la-daqiqəna ʾəḥzē ʾansa nāhu ʾərēʾəy mawʿā la-sabʾ

i18n.en: And now, behold, I see that we ourselves shall again be brought to destruction for our children — for I see the destruction of mankind.

paragraphs.text: ወአንሰ፡ ሰማዕኩ፡ ናሁ፡ ሰይጣናተ፡ አኀዙ፡ ያስሕትዎሙ፡ ለደቂቅክሙ፡ ወይትገበር፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ኩናኔ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾansa samāʿku nāhu sayṭānāta ʾaḫazu yāsḥətəwomu la-daqiqəkəmu wa-yətgabbar kiyāhomu kwənnānē

i18n.en: And I have heard that the demons have begun to lead astray your children; and judgment shall be wrought upon them.

notes.official: Proto-Mastema material: 'the demons began to lead astray the children of the sons of Noah' — prefigures the full Mastema material at ch 10.

paragraphs.text: ወሰብእ፡ ዘይዜምው፡ ምስለ፡ ሰብእ፡ ይትጋዱል፡ በምድር፡ ወዘይክዐው፡ ደመ፡ በምድር፡ ይትገበር፡ ፍትሕ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-sabʾ zayəzēmmuwə məsla sabʾ yətgāddul ba-mədr wa-zayəkəʿaw dama ba-mədr yətgabbar fətḥ

i18n.en: And the man who fornicates with a man shall be afflicted upon the earth; and he who sheds blood upon the earth — upon him shall judgment be done.

paragraphs.text: ወወልድ፡ ዘይዜምው፡ ምስለ፡ እኅቱ፡ ወብእሲት፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ዘይትዐዘዝ፡ ቅቱላን፡ ይኩኑ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-wald zayəzēmmuwə məsla ʾəḫətu wa-bəʾəsit məsla bəʾəsi za-ʾalbo la-sabʾ zayətʿazzəzə qətulān yəkunu

i18n.en: And the son who lies with his sister, and the wife with another man's husband — those for whom no man has commanded them — they shall be put to death.

paragraphs.text: ወዐቀባ፡ ለነፍሰክሙ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግፍዕ፡ ወእምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዐመፃ፡ ወእምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኀጢአት፡ ወእምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዓመፃ፡ ወእምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘይነጥቅ፡ መሐለ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʿaqabā la-nafsakəmu ʾəm-nə kwəlu gəfʿ wa-ʾəm-nə kwəlu ʿamaḍā wa-ʾəm-nə kwəlu ḫāṭiʾat wa-ʾəm-nə kwəlu ʿāmaḍā wa-ʾəm-nə kwəlu zayənaṭṭəq maḥala

i18n.en: Keep your souls from all violence, and from all iniquity, and from all sin, and from all lawlessness, and from everyone who breaks an oath.

paragraphs.text: ወሥርዐት፡ ዘመሐለ፡ ኖኅ፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ጽሑፍ፡ ዘመጻኦ፡ ለሎቱ፡ በዕለታት፡ ዘይትዘከር፡ ለመዋዕለ፡ ለትውልዶሙ፡ ለዓለም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-śərʿat zamaḥala Noḫ la-daqiqu ṣəḥuf zamaṣaʾo la-lottu ba-ʿəlatāt zayətzakkar la-mawāʿəl la-təwlədomu la-ʿālam

i18n.en: And the ordinance which Noah swore for his sons was written down, as it came to him in the days — a memorial for the appointed times of their generations for ever.

paragraphs.text: ወባሕቱ፡ አንትሙ፡ ደቂቅየ፡ ዐቀባ፡ ለነፍሰክሙ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ግፍዕ፡ ዘገብሩ፡ መዋዕለ፡ አባዊክሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-bāḥtu ʾantəmu daqiqəya ʿaqabā la-nafsakəmu ʾəm-nə kwəlu śərʿata gəfʿ zagabru mawāʿəla ʾabāwikəmu

i18n.en: But as for you, my children, keep your souls from all the manner of violence which your fathers practiced in their days.

paragraphs.text: እስመ፡ ምድር፡ ትሬኢ፡ ኵሎ፡ ግብር፡ ዘይትገበር፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ ወትትዜከር፡ ኵሎ፡ በዕለታት፡ ኩናኔ፡
paragraphs.translit: ʾəsma mədr tərēʾi kwəlo gəbər zayətgabbar lāʿlēhā wa-tətzēkar kwəlo ba-ʿəlatāt kwənnānē

i18n.en: For the earth sees every deed that is done upon it, and remembers every one of them in the day of judgment.

paragraphs.text: ወይኬብርን፡ ምድር፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግፍዕ፡ ወእምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኀጢአት፡ ወእምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግዕዝ፡ ዘይትገበር፡ ላዕሌሃ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəkēbbərən mədr ʾəm-nə kwəlu gəfʿ wa-ʾəm-nə kwəlu ḫāṭiʾat wa-ʾəm-nə kwəlu gəʿz zayətgabbar lāʿlēhā

i18n.en: And the earth shall be defiled by all violence, and by all sin, and by every nature of evil that is wrought upon it.

paragraphs.text: ወበራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡ ይኩን፡ ቅዱስ፡ ፍሬሁ፡ ቡሩከ፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚእ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-rābəʿ ʿāmat la-la-ʿāmat yəkun qəddusə fərehu buruka qədma ʾəgziʾ

i18n.en: And in the fourth year, year by year, the fruit shall be holy — a blessing before the Lord.

paragraphs.text: ወበኃምስ፡ ዓመት፡ ይትበላዕ፡ ፍሬሁ፡ ለርእስከ፡ ሐራ፡ ቡሩከ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚእ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-ḫāməs ʿāmat yətballāʿ fərehu la-rəʾəsəka ḥarā buruka ḫaba ʾəgziʾ

i18n.en: And in the fifth year the fruit shall be eaten for yourself — released, blessed before the Lord.

paragraphs.text: በከመ፡ አዘዘ፡ አብርሃም፡ አባሁ፡ ለይስሐቅ፡ ወይስሐቅ፡ ለያዕቆብ፡ ወያዕቆብ፡ ለ፫ ደቂቁ፡ እምነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ኖኅ፡ እስከ፡ መዋዕለ፡ አብርሃም፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-kama ʾazaza ʾAbrəhām ʾabbāhu la-Yəsḥaq wa-Yəsḥaq la-Yāʿqob wa-Yāʿqob la-3 daqiqu ʾəm-nə mawāʿəla Noḫ ʾəska mawāʿəla ʾAbrəhām

i18n.en: Even as Abraham his father commanded Isaac, and Isaac Jacob, and Jacob his three sons — from the days of Noah unto the days of Abraham.

paragraphs.text: በከመ፡ መሐራ፡ ሄኖክ፡ ለማቱሳላ፡ ወልዱ፡ ወማቱሳላ፡ ለላሜክ፡ ወልዱ፡ ወላሜክ፡ ለኖኅ፡ ወልዱ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘመሐርዎ፡ አበዊሁ፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-kama maḥarā Henok la-Mātusālā waldu wa-Mātusālā la-Lāmek waldu wa-Lāmek la-Noḫ waldu kwəlo zamaḥarəwo ʾabawihu

i18n.en: Even as Enoch instructed Methuselah his son, and Methuselah instructed Lamech his son, and Lamech instructed Noah his son — all that their fathers had instructed them.

paragraphs.text: ወአንሰ፡ ኒሁ፡ ኦደቂቅየ፡ እኤዝዘክሙ፡ በከመ፡ አዘዘኒ፡ ሄኖክ፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ዘሕያው፡ ሎቱ፡ ምስለ፡ መላእክተ፡ እግዚእ፡ ይነግረኒ፡ ኵሎ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾansa naḫu ʾo daqiqəya ʾəʾēzəzəkəmu ba-kama ʾazazani Henok ba-qadāmāwi ʾiyobēləwu zaḥəyāw lottu məsla malāʾəkta ʾəgziʾ yənaggərani kwəlo

i18n.en: And I, behold, my children, do command you according as Enoch commanded me in the first jubilee — Enoch, who is living with the angels of the Lord, and he tells me all.
